goals: Reconcile V3-82 through V3-88 technical receipts and boundaries
Produce a reviewer-facing, label-masked, six-clip packet assembled ONLY from exact SHA verified MP4 artifacts
Define falsifiable 5-axis human pedagogical acceptance requiring actual human ratings
Keep automated source QA separated from educational outcomes
selection_rule: Exactly two frozen real native MP4s per semantic family: affine Math development and Physics heldout; both V3-88 Fraction cases; both V3-88 Binary Search cases. Phys dev V3-87 excluded to retain balanced 2 per family, not because of score. No substitution or clips generated anew.
pairing_rule: Mapping hidden from reviewer packet, but known to project administrators; footage reveals topic so this is not content-blind, double-blind or randomized controlled design.

reviewer_protocol.accepting_threshold: Each clip has two distinct valid reviewer records; every clip per-axis median >=3; every clip overall mean >=4; no clip with any reviewer semantic_correctness<=2; at least 2 reviewers provide an identifiable reviewer_id (pseudonyms, not emails). Gate MUST remain PENDING until real ratings entered; an unfinished review is NOT FAIL, not PASS.
reviewer_protocol.do_not_pretend_independence: Two accounts can be asserted distinct but not proven independent by code; actual recruitment and consent are manual.
reviewer_protocol.input_format: human_reviews.csv outside reviewer packet, only created upon human submission

machine_controls.source_files: ZIP archives downloaded from exact historical GitHub workflow artifact IDs, no generated replacement media
machine_controls.check_each: original bytes SHA-256, exact 15fps 1280x720 H264/AAC, frame count, full H264 decode, original V3-88 source negative ABSTAIN receipts, samples 15/50/85 percent per clip
machine_controls.export: six renamed copied MP4s plus 3-frame review contact sheets per clip and blank scoring form
